# Code Tau
## Called by:
Central Command. Use a Communications Console or Fax Machine in order to explain the situation. Tau should only be requested if the only feasible alternative is evacuation. Having a well-written, concise fax that explains the situation to the best of your ability, as well as why it deserves Code Tau being called, signed and stamped by the Captain or Acting Captain, goes a long way towards ensuring Tau is provided.
Central Command may also elect to call Code Tau of their own accord based on the contents of a Communications Console Announcement. There will be penalties for misuse of this system.
## Conditions:
The station is currently being overwhelmed by nonsentient hostile threats, and Security personnel are either highly lacking or entirely absent.
## Security:
1. Any Security personnel are to continue their duties to the best of their ability. Security personnel may be issued Code Red armaments by Command if access to the armory is possible.
2. Security personnel should not attempt to relieve weaponry from crew unless said weaponry is being actively misused or there is a reasonable concern for the wellbeing of the possessing crewmember or their peers. An exception is made for Highly Illegal equipment, which remains permissible via Central Command approved permit only.
3. An armory will be deployed. Any available Security personnel should assist in distributing their contents them to able-bodied and willing crew in order to handle the infestation. Crew have general authorisation to arm unless explicitly commanded otherwise by the highest ranking Command personnel. Prisoners and visitors are not to be armed.
## Secure Areas:
1. Secure areas are limited to Command, Security, relevant departmental personnel, and Central Command personnel.
2. Secure areas: Security department, EVA Storage, Tech Storage, Gravity Generator, all Engineering areas beyond the lobby, Vault, and areas requiring Command access.
3. Secure areas may be bolted if attempted unauthorized access is likely. Procedures for secure areas should otherwise reflect that of Code Blue.
## Medical:
It is recommended that medical entrances be set to emergency access to allow personnel to heal themselves in emergencies.
## General Crew:
1. A general waiver of all permits for weaponry of Minor or Major Class Contraband is issued. Personnel may freely possess any lawfully obtained weapons in these categories for the duration of the alert.
2. All personnel are highly encouraged to set their suit sensors to coordinates.
3. Personnel should shelter in their departments where possible, and travel in pairs at the least otherwise. Crew should not enter Maintenance unarmed.
4. Visitors to the station are to remain inside the Bar, Library, or Dormitories.
5. Personnel are to follow the instructions of Command staff, so long as they are within the bounds of Corporate Law and are not acting against the general well-being of the station and its crew.
